notes.title: PATCH NOTES #12
notes.notes:
[b]FEATURES[/b]

[list]
[*][b]A new game mode has been added - Last Man Standing![/b]
 [*]The last one alive wins the round in this fast paced, round based mode.
 [*]You can't come back once you are out - but as always, you can let your spite run wild by getting other people in trouble via spectator mode!
 [*]Players must reach a win count based on the amount of players, as well as reaching a lead of 2 rounds or more, to win the match.
 [*]If no clear winner is decided after a certain amount of rounds, a Final Round occurs, where the winner takes all, even if you were behind up to that point. Keep fighting even if you fall behind!

[*][b]A new feature has been added - the Training Room![/b]
 [*]This replaces the placeholder tutorial videos we had up to this point.
 [*]A freely playable area with training hints and information on how to use your skills, grenades, upgrades, how to pick up the orb or score with the bomb, a firing range, and a practice area where you can spawn bots and fight freely.
 [*]Players can swap between weapons and grenades freely and manipulate the training room in more ways than they typically could in normal gameplay. Explore the area and find out!
 [*]As a result of implementing this, we have removed the tutorial video section in the main menu.

[*][b]Two new weapons have been added, the Goliath and Valkyrie![/b]
  [*]This pistol and rifle are both charging variants of the original. 
  [*]Hold down the fire button to create a shot that will deal significantly more damage than the weapon would have done with normal fire!
   [*]The Goliath can consume its entire clip in one charged barrage!
   [*]The Valkyrie can combine 3 ammo into one powerful shot.

[*][b]A new Grenade has been added, the EMP Grenade![/b]
 [*]EMP has the ability to disrupt the information your opponent receives.
 [*]Being hit by the blast of an EMP will prevent you from casting your Echo, disrupt the information shown by your HUD, and cause false positive enemy silhouettes to appear.
 [*]Use this confusion alongside your other tools to defeat your enemies!
[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[list]
[*]There has been some iterative balance work on the existing weapons. 
[*]The HUD in game has undergone a full overhaul, and should hopefully feel cleaner and easier to understand.
[*]You wont see the diegetic HUD on your weapon when using ADS anymore - instead a small marker at your crosshair will let you know what ammo you have left.
[*]You can now inspect your weapon hitting the “i” key in active gameplay. Make sure you are somewhere you can see it…
[*]Incremental improvements have been made to performance on several maps.
[*]Some gantries now have strip lights running down them that can be activated.
[/list]


[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

[list]
[*]Bots have overcome their problems aiming with melee attacks.
[*]Bots should be able to score consistently in Touchdown mode again.
[*]We identified further areas where it was possible for a grenade to hit geometry unexpectedly.
[/list]


[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]

[list]
[*]It's possible the armoury may appear blank the next time you enter it, if you were in it when a game starts.
[*]On rare occasions it is possible the Combat Training area within the Training Room is lit up - it should be shrouded in darkness in the same way normal maps are.
[*]If this happens, leaving and re-entering the training room should resolve the issue.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #11
notes.notes:
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]

[b]The first rifle has been added - the Cerberus![/b]
 - This semi-automatic rifle packs a massive punch, but with only 3 rounds per mag, every shot counts.
   - Unique to this weapon, you can't reload early, and will reload automatically upon the clip emptying.
  - A couple of skins have been added for the cerberus, with more coming soon!

[b]A new match type has been added - Wingman![/b]
  - Protect each other as you advance in this Best of 5, 2v2 specialised mode.
  - If your partner dies, hide or protect yourself until they are able to respawn - the round only ends if both players on a team are dead at the same time.
  - The dead player is, of course, free to use traps to endanger the other team while waiting…
  - 2 new, small scale maps have been added to accommodate the game mode, complete with another new feature...

[b]A new feature, Upgrades, has been implemented![/b]
 - Upgrades are in-map pick ups that let you turn the tide of the battle in your favour.
 - Upgrade spawn points have been dotted around maps for all modes except Bodycount. Just remember everyone can see them before you run for them!
 - Upgrades come in 4 varieties;
  - Med-pack: Gives you an immediate burst of healing, as well as a further limited amount of healing over time. Patch up and get back in there!
  - Overdrive: Gives all of your weapon damage a boost for a limited period. Go for the kill!
  - Echo Repeater: Causes your echo to continually trigger for a limited period, giving you tactical superiority over the opponents. Search and Destroy!
  - Overshield: Treat yourself to a second health bar in the form of a shield! Just don’t get overconfident…
 - Upgrades respawn after a period of time, so ride out the storm and you will get another chance soon!
 - But for the strategic minded, upgrades can also be destroyed by shooting them. Consider your approach before making a move!

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

- Bots have continued to receive incremental improvements. They should be now a little more prone to exploring, and reacting to traps activated by living players.
- Bots are also already able to function in the new Wingman mode.
- We are continuing to make incremental changes to the UI - the new mode has the new in-match scoreboards already present.

[b]FIXES AND CHANGES[/b]

- Some objects that were incorrectly blocking grenade throws have been fixed to allow grenades through. We will continue to improve this as we find specific issues.
- Bots should more carefully make their jumps, so as not to potentially get stuck.
- Custom Game Anti-Camp should now function as expected.
- Button Prompts should update as expected.
- “Invalid” has been done away with, and they shouldn’t be responsible for your death any longer.

[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]

- Bots aim low with melee attacks, causing them to miss even when you aren’t moving.
- Any movement on your part will have them shooting again, short term.
- Bots have a chance of not understanding the need to use launch pads to reach the goal in Shadowline Stadium.

notes.title: Patch 8
notes.notes:
Hello, Contestants! Patch 8 is now available, introducing new features and bug fixes. Check out all the details below!
[h2]New features[/h2]
[h3][b]New match type - Touchdown[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Compete for control of our new, most dangerous companion, BOMB.BO, and deliver them to the goal to score points in an explosive fashion!
[*] Alternatively, throw it at the goal! A thrown goal will still score points, albeit less than if you deliver it by hand.
[*] Use the Goalkeeper spectator interaction to protect your goal even in death, preventing players from reaching it, while delivering a nasty shock. Shocked players are slowed, can't shoot, and will drop the BOMB.BO if they were holding it.
[*] Lastly, no one likes a ball hog. Don't let BOMB.BO count down to zero, or there will be consequences!
[*] For now, bots will function in this mode the same as with Spotlight. Bots will attempt to attack or defend the orb holder, but will not carry the orb themselves. You need at least 2 human players to begin a Touchdown match, one per team.
[/list]
[h3][b]Voice Chat[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will be able to chat with anyone in the squad lobby if you are joining together ahead of gameplay.
[*] In game, who you can chat to depends on the situation…
[*] While alive, you can talk to your team directly with V, or by selecting the Team channel using Dpad down on a controller.
[*] You can also talk in proximity chat to those physically around you, using Alt or selecting the Proximity channel using Dpad down on a controller.
[*] Involved in a takedown? Killer and victim have a few seconds of direct open mic chat immediately after the takedown occurs.
[*] During spectator mode, you can talk freely with all other spectators, regardless of team.
[*] During all other gameplay elements (Map showcase, end of round, winners showcase), voice chat is open to everyone!
[*] Of course, you can mute yourself, individuals and even everyone in the match easily if you want to opt out of the feature.
[/list]
[h3][b]XP and Progression system[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Completing games earns you experience towards your Player Profile Rank, and at specific levels you can unlock new goodies!
[*] Winning, scoring takedowns, scoring multi-kills... everything you do will add small amounts of experience to your total at the end of the match.
[*] The only situation in which you don't get experience is if you leave a match before the match completes. So stay in the game, and fight to the bitter end!
[*] We have included several new cosmetic skin sets, weapon skins and masks, as well as new skin tones, and even newer Tracer and Charm cosmetic types.
[*] There might be something special at the end for those who make it all the way!
[/list]
[h3][b]Armoury[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] This is a new menu that lives inside the squad lobby, next to the Locker.
[*] The Armoury contains everything regarding weapon customisation, including the new [b]Tracer[/b] and [b]Charm[/b] cosmetics.
[*] Charms are attached to your weapon and add a little personal flair!
[*] Tracers affect the colour of your gunfire!
[*] The arrival of the Armoury also spells a change in how we handle which weapons you use in a match.
[*] We now have a loadout system! Each round will designate the weapon type to be used, but the specific variant you equip is based on your selection in the armoury menu.
[*] This means you can now go head-to-head with a Scarab user whilst wielding your trusty Mantis.
[*] Please note that weapon skins have been moved from the Locker to the Armoury!
[*] We intend to add more options to this menu… soon 🙂
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] We have implemented a new system for queuing into gameplay. Quickplay and Custom remain the same. Instead of Solo and Squad, we now have [b]The Crucible[/b] and [b]War Games[/b]. The Crucible restricts your search to Bodycount and Team Bodycount only. War Games includes all match types apart from Bodycount and Team Bodycount.
[*] New controller options have been added! In particular, much requested input acceleration and deadzone manipulation options should now be present and functional.
[*] A new Announcer and ABI assistant voice over has been added!
[*] A new post-match screen has been added where you can see your performance in the prior game. 
[*] The options available in Custom Matches have been expanded! Expect to see more options appearing in later updates, too.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Slow Reload should no longer become disabled over time.
[*] Name plates should appear as normal again, although they are now positional, and will hide where players are obstructed.
[*] Losing internet connection should once again return you to the title screen.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you start firing directly after sprinting, the animation will look like you are firing upwards (although any bullets will be fired in the correct direction)
[*] The button prompt for quick respawn may not update in game if you change it from its default
[*] On Abyssal Ascent, bots spawning on a specific spawn point may become unable to move from the point.
[*] When killed by bots, the game will occasionally tell you you were killed by KillerName, instead of the name of the bot that killed you.
[*] Very rarely, after picking up the BOMB.BO you will be unable to throw it correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 7
notes.notes:
Hello, Contestants! Patch 7 is now available, bringing changes to some of the recently released features as well as high priority bug fixes. Check out all the details below!

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list][*] We have enabled [b]Custom Games for single players[/b]. This should allow you to generate games of your choice with bots if you just want to get into some action!
[*] The only mode you can't Custom Game alone is Spotlight, as that currently requires a human player on each side to pick up BORB.EE.
[*]We have enabled the matchmaking server to [b]match you with bots if no one else is available[/b] in the queue.
[*]The matchmaking server will, of course, always prefer to match players together before starting a bot game.
[*]Currently the server will revert to creating a bot game after [b]4 minutes[/b]. We may revise this down in future updates.[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] The bots have overcome their fear of Nightvoid Gap, and are willing to explore it once more.
[*] Resolved a controller navigation issue in the squad lobby, while playing as a host during matchmaking, that prevented the user from accessing the Locker.
[*] Resolved a minor graphical issue in the mode select screen.
[*] Resolved an issue where the options menu would occasionally give options for something it shouldn’t! (stay tuned)[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] Enabled some changes that should significantly improve performance at low graphical settings.[/list]

notes.title: Patch 6
notes.notes:
Hello, Contestants! Patch 6 is now available, introducing new features and bug fixes. Check out all the details below!
[h2]New features[/h2]
[h3][b]New match type[/b][/h3]
A new match type - [b]Spotlight[/b] - has been added.
[list][*] This match type is [b]Squad based only[/b].
[*] The match is a best of 3 rounds.
[*] Fight over control of our adorable new companion, BORB.EE, and collect points for your team for each second you hold it in hand.
[*] While holding BORB.EE, you cant use your weapons and you are lit up, but you also have infinite sprint and a healing factor to keep you on the move! You can also drop or even throw BORB.EE to one of your teammates! 
[*] The first team to accrue 100 points wins the round.
[*] To improve the experience of matches on multi-height maps, we have added [b]gantry-level spawn points[/b]. These will be available in both Spotlight and Kill Race.[/list]
[h3][b]Custom Matches[/b][/h3]
[b]Custom Matches[/b] have been added to the lobby options!
- This option only appears when you have at least 2 players in your squad.
- The squad lobby can now support 8 players to facilitate full custom matches. If the squad has more than 4 players, Custom Matches will be your only option.
- Rather than going into matchmaking, you will be allocated a server directly. Upon selecting [b]custom[/b], you will be able to edit;
[list][*] Match type
[*] Map
[*] Weapon Selection
[*] Bot Participation (explained below shortly!)[/list]

[h3][b]Bots[/b][/h3]
A first implementation of [b]Bots[/b] has been added! Bots are now available in a variety of ways…
[list][*] If matchmaking can't find enough players to make a full game, it will add bots to cover the difference for you.
[*] It will still prefer smaller capacity full player-based game modes, like the small variant of Kill Race, if possible.
[*] If you enable the option in Custom Games, bots will fill the spaces remaining in your lobby.
[*] If a player leaves mid-game, they will be replaced with a bot.[/list]
- Bots are capable of reacting to both light and sound from other players in their vicinity, and will do their best to track players they have seen, to bring them down. 
- In [b]Spotlight[/b] mode, bots on both teams will attempt to protect/attack the player holding BORB.EE, rather than trying to pick it up themselves. (Since this mode should only start with at least one human player on each side)
- Bots are a work in progress, and we will improve them as time goes on.

[h3][b]Spectator Assists[/b][/h3]
In [b]Bodycount[/b] and [b]Team Bodycount[/b], players are now able to gain points through [b]Spectator Assists![/b]
[list][*] If you light up a player with one of the spectator interactions throughout the maps, and they die within a short period afterwards, you will be awarded a [b]Spectator Assist[/b], worth 10 points, just like an assist in live gameplay!
[*] With this, even if you die early in the round, you can still continue to earn points and keep pace with people who survive longer.
[*] Don’t give up, and [b]light ‘em up![/b] [/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Main Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] The Announcer has finally agreed to slow down during Kill Race.
[*] The announcer should no longer declare a Draw when there is a clear winner.
[i][b]Please note[/b][/i]: in Bodycount mode, the round winner is decided via points, rather than who the final survivor is.
[*] The pause menu should no longer re-appear next round, if you are in it when the round ends.
[*] Players should now display the correct cosmetics in the lobby, mid-match, and in the winners showcase.
[i][b]Please note[/b][/i]: As a result of resolving this bug, cosmetic skin loadouts have unfortunately been deleted. Please create your favourite look once more!
[*] Small Kill Race groups should no longer spawn in with Big Kill Race rules.
[*] Keybinds should no longer sometimes misbehave and trigger both new and old function at the same time.
[*] Traps obscured behind walls/objects should be a bit more visually clear.
[*] There should no longer be rare instances of player names not appearing in the lobby.[/list]

[h3]Main Known Issues[/h3]
[list][*] If you start firing directly after sprinting, the animation will look like you are firing upwards (although any bullets will be fired in the correct direction)
[*] 1 player may have a blank name plate while in spectator freecam mode.
[*] Having your controller disconnected and reconnected in the middle of a match has a small chance of causing Slow Reload to stop working. Restarting the game will resolve this if it happens to you.
[*] Losing internet connection may not cancel matchmaking and send you back to the title screen.[/list]

notes.title: Dev Blog #2
notes.notes:
Today’s the day! We’ve rolled out a mini content update with some nice surprises to spice up your Blindfire gameplay. Think of it as a small box with a big, shiny bow. Except instead of a bow, it’s traps. Lots of traps! Nervous? You should be. Here’s a breakdown of all the new additions to Blindfire:

[u][b]WORKER’S FORGOTTEN LAMP[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/db0edb3e9d107a5cea4f827083953b9b29f3a986.png[/img]
The Worker’s Forgotten Lamp is a new illumination trap with a wide area of effect. When triggered, it floods the nearby surroundings with bright white light and emits a distinct sound, making it nearly impossible to stay hidden. If you stumble into one, try to make the most of it. And if you get exposed? Well, sprint as fast as possible because that blinding light will make you an irresistibly easy target.

[u][b]CONTAINER TRAP[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/a730192fb624adc8a878d99f6ec23cadd4dba681.png[/img]
Containers were top-tier hiding spots in Blindfire, until now. Meet the Container Trap, your new worst nightmare. While the lasers in this trap are not lethal (despite their intimidating vibes), they will mess up your day if you accidentally set it off. So go ahead, keep hiding in those containers. We dare you…

[u][b]SHUTTER “TRAP”[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/9d9cd2948422898effea467e0a7b7823e4d25bc7.png[/img]
Okay, technically this isn’t a “trap”, BUT it is incredibly useful. The Shutter lets you seal off key routes on the map, forcing your enemies to take an alternative path or awkwardly stand around waiting for the door to open. Whether you’re blocking enemies to give your team a breather or trolling as a spectator by repeatedly shutting the gates, the strategy is entirely up to you.

[b][u]UV HORIZONTAL LIGHT[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/596891f35ce84c0cb5e7ae480005bd4a455c8105.png[/img]
Let there be light. UV light! The UV Horizontal Light not only exposes you and showcases your fabulous cosmetics, but also adds another fun layer of strategy to your gameplay. Here’s a tip! Most traps in the game, including this one, can be activated by shooting them. Did you know that? No? Well, now you do. Go forth and start shooting at random lamps.

[b][u]NEW FREE COSMETICS[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/3b9fb742d22f5d8a74e64b4a42d3ef3e7c8a75de.png[/img]
It wouldn’t be an update without some fresh drip, right? We’re bringing you 10 new masks, 5 new outfits, and 2 new weapon skins that apply to every weapon currently in the game. That’s a lot of options to flex on your opponents with. Personally I’m a big fan of the new Uzumaki mask. Which one is your favorite?

[u][b]NEW TUTORIAL HUB[/b][/u]
Blindfire is deeper than it looks, and we want everyone to hit the ground running. That’s why we’ve introduced a shiny new Tutorial Hub! It features a series of short, easy-to-follow videos designed to help new players learn the ropes. So, if you’ve been struggling to explain the game to your friends and family, tell them to watch it because let’s face it, we all need more recruits to grow the awesome Blindfire community during this early access phase!

[u][b]NOTE:[/b][/u] A more immersive, hands-on tutorial experience is in the works for the future, but for now, these videos will make sure everyone gets the basics of mechanics and game modes down.

That’s everything for today! Don’t worry, January is just around the corner, and with it comes another great content update. Until then, I’ll see you all in the arena. Stay sneaky, stay deadly, and try not to get caught in a trap (or do, for science).

Cheers!
Pedro Silva, Community Manager

notes.title: PATCH 5 is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[u][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/u]

[b]New Map[/b]
- A new small map has been added for use in Killrace - Nocturne Bridge!
     - This is a smaller version of the maps used for Kill Race, and will appear mainly when a kill race game begins with a lobby of 2-4 players.
- To help players flow through the system more easily, we have created custom kill race rules where the lobby consists of 4 players or less.
     - Lobbies of this size will now generally spawn into the new, smaller map.
     - The time limit and kill requirements of lobbies with this amount of players will be lower than normal.
     - Please note that if a game tried to load in 5 players, and 1 failed, leaving 4, the game will still load in as a “large” lobby.

[u][b]NEW TRAPS[/b][/u]
- A variety of new traps have been added! Catch out friends and enemies alike in new and creative ways.
     - The new traps can be activated as a spectator too, so don't let them go just because they eliminated you!
     - Armed Mannequins have also learned to adapt their weapon loadout to the situation around them. Clever!

[u][b]NEW COSMETICS[/b][/u]
- A variety of new free cosmetic sets, as well as new independent mask cosmetics and weapon  cosmetics have been added! You will be able to find them all in your locker in the game. 

[u][b]TUTORIAL HUB[/b][/u]
- The Tutorial Hub has been added! Get tips and tricks on how to approach the game before you jump in.

[u][b]FIXES AND CHANGES[/b][/u]
- A warning has been added to the lobby to let you know when crossplay is disabled for the session you are in.
- When entering spectator mode, the camera should no longer get stuck in objects or outside the map bounds, and should react to player input immediately.
- The announcer should be less inclined to react to kills as first blood again.
- You should no longer be prevented from respawning and end up softlocked if two players are assigned the same respawn pod due to auto-respawn, or you select a respawn pod in the same frame it is assigned to someone else.
     - The game should now simply retry auto-respawning a second later.
- You should no longer lose access to VFX on consoles when moving between Performance and Quality
     - If this were to still occur, you can still fix it by restarting the game.

[u][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/u]
- If you are in the settings menu as a spectator when the round ends, the menu will reopen once the new round begins.
- If you start firing directly after sprinting, the animation will look like you are firing upwards (although any bullets will be fired in the correct direction)
- The announcer can (still) be a little… overzealous at times.
     - He will sometimes announce a draw when there is a clear winner. This now typically occurs when a player leaving causes the game to end.

- After you respawn, you will sometimes spawn with the incorrect weapon skin.
- In the winners showcase, you may sometimes spawn with the incorrect skin (primarily on PC)
- You can occasionally spawn into Nocturne Bridge despite having a “large” lobby.
     - We are curious, how do you feel about playing on this smaller map with 8 players?
- Very rarely, a “small” lobby will still load in with the large lobby rules for Killrace, though still in the smaller map.

notes.title: PATCH 4 is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello, Contestants! Patch 4 is now available for download on all platforms, bringing with it a host of important fixes. Check out all the details below: 

[u][b]FIXES AND CHANGES[/b][/u]
- You can now correctly trigger a trap in spectator mode, then activate a respawn pod - the cooldown between the two have been disconnected.
- Crossplay settings now visually change as they should. For the time being, they are still Off by default on the Playstation 5.
- VSync now behaves as expected. No more hogging the spotlight!
- The Settings menu no longer causes the game's audio to mute.
- The respawn timer between deaths on Killrace should once again be visible on console variants of the game.
- While the game is in Simplified Chinese, the kill feed should once again display correctly.
- The announcer should be a little less overzealous, but there is more work to be done here.

[u][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/u]
- If you are in the settings menu as a spectator when the round ends, the menu will reopen once the new round begins.
- If you start firing directly after sprinting, the animation will look like you are firing upwards (although any bullets will be fired in the correct direction)

- Both the player and their drone can fail to move immediately if you were holding forward before gaining control.
- The announcer can (still) be a little… overzealous at times.
- He will sometimes announce a draw when there is a clear winner.
- He will sometimes announce First Blood when that isn't the case.
- After you respawn, you will sometimes spawn with the incorrect weapon skin.
- On consoles, if you repeatedly move between Quality and Performance modes, you may lose VFX (for example, muzzle flashes or explosions from barrels). 
- This can be resolved by restarting the game.
- On consoles, a rare soft lock can occur if the game tries to auto-respawn 2 different players on the same respawn point at the same time, or if a player selects a respawn pod on the same frame where an auto-respawn occurs on that pod.

notes.title: Blindfire Dev Blog: Race to Kill
notes.notes:
Ow do, Everyone!

Matt here - Lead Designer on [i][b]Blindfire[/b][/i], the arena shooter where total darkness is just another weapon in your arsenal. 

Today, I’m absolutely buzzing to share details about our first major update, [b]Race to Kill[/b], which is already available on all platforms. We’ve loaded it up with new features, powerful weapons, and some massive maps, but the star of the show is undoubtedly Kill Race.

Grab a brew, your favourite biscuits and settle in. It’s time to take a closer look at what’s coming to Blindfire next.

[b]KILL RACE: SHOOT TO WIN, FAST![/b]

At its core, [b]Blindfire[/b] has always been about turning the unknown dangers of the darkness into tactical opportunities. With [b]Kill Race[/b], we wanted to crank up the intensity of our pitch-black fights to the death. It’s fast, it’s highly competitive and it’s brilliantly chaotic. 

What’s the objective? Rack up kills faster than anyone else. Simple. It's every player for themselves, but don’t worry - there’s a [b]Team Kill Race[/b] variant for those of you who’d prefer to squad up (and blame your mates when things go pearshaped like I do).

[b]Here’s what makes Kill Race a thrill:[/b]
[b]- Dynamic Respawns:[/b] Every time you’re eliminated, you’ll choose your respawn point from a bird’s-eye view of the arena. Then get launched into the action via a very snazzy retro-futuristic pod, and you’re back in the fight within seconds.
[b]- Non-Stop Action:[/b] The pace of Kill Race is unlike anything we’ve done before. With minimal downtime, you’ll spend more time fragging and less time sulking about being fragged.

If you would like to see an exciting match of Kill Race before jumping into the game, watch our latest video:
[previewyoutube=nr7iXOh9dTQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]NEW MAPS: SIZE MATTERS… AND SO DOES HEIGHT[/b]

For [b]Kill Race[/b], we’ve designed two brand-new maps, both of which are twice the size of our existing [b]Bodycount[/b] arenas. The biggest difference? Verticality. These maps give you more room to manoeuvre, but they also let you climb - literally - to new heights. 

Imagine this with me: you are perched on up on the gantry, surveying the chaos below, waiting to line up your shot… only to realise you’re completely exposed up here. Batman, you are not. It’s risk-versus-reward, it’s a bit of a gamble, and we’re excited to see the creative playstyles you’ll dream up.

Whether you’re the type to skulk in the shadows or to take the high ground like Obi-Wan, these maps bring new tactics to exploit and fresh dangers to fear to Blindfire’s gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/84fbe2d1536362cba7710f1336e2553aa0b0741d.png[/img]

[b]RESPAWN PODS: BRINGING YOU BACK IN NO TIME![/b]

The respawn mechanic in [b]Kill Race[/b] isn’t just functional - it’s bloody cool (if I do say so myself). When you’re taken out, you’ll get a top-down view of the arena with all the lights on and your opponents flagged clearly, so you can plan your glorious re-entry and your climb up the scoreboard. 

That’s not the cool part though, you’ll then be fired up into the arena via a very stylish respawn pod that wouldn’t look out of place in a 80s sci-fi film. It’s practical, it’s cinematic, and yes, it’s the perfect moment for your teammates to shout, “MATT! Could you not just have stayed dead, you’re dragging us down” (Although, perhaps that’s just me, no one seems to appreciate my next-level tactics)

[b]NEW TOOLS OF DESTRUCTION: SCARAB & IMPUNITY[/b]

What’s an update without shiny new ways to eliminate your opponents? Enter the [b]Scarab[/b] and the [b]Impunity[/b], two weapons that couldn’t be more different, but are equally fun to wield.

[b]- The Scarab:[/b] Think rapid fire. It’s an automatic pistol with a fire rate that borders on the absurd. Great for close quarters battles, not so great if you’re trying to stay hidden though.
[b]- The Impunity:[/b] A burst-fire shotgun that pulls no punches. Two shots per trigger pull means double the damage - and double the recoil. If you can control it, you’ll be unstoppable.

These weapons are perfect for Kill Race’s fast-paced gameplay, so don’t hold back! Experiment and find your favourite.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/87d0525267c2761f715192dda11c7dc06726fc6e.png[/img]

[b]THE ELITE 10 - CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS, CLAIM GLORY![/b]

For those of you who thrive on competition, we’re introducing [b]The Elite 10[/b] - leaderboards that highlight the best of the best across three categories:

[b]- Total Kills:[/b] Prove you’re the deadliest contestant in the arena.
[b]- Points Scored:[/b] Outthink and outplay your opponents with strategic flair.
[b]- Matches Won:[/b] For those front and centre during the Winner’s Showcase time after time.

Earning a spot in the [b]Elite 10[/b] isn’t for the faint of heart, but the glory? Oh, it’s worth it. Perhaps we can put some prizes on the line for the end of the season… 🤔

[b]The Race to Kill[/b] update it’s a glimpse into the future of Blindfire. We’ll continue to build on your feedback and push the boundaries of what’s possible in this pitch-black world. With the game now available on PlayStation 5 as well, it has never been easier to jump into a match with your friends and experience everything Blindfire has to offer. We hope to see you in the arena very soon! 🫡

[i]- Light ‘em up! [/i]

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Contestants![/h3]
The new [i]Blindfire [/i]update, [b]Race to Kill[/b], will be released today in most regions at around midnight UTC. We’re posting the patch notes ahead of time so you can get a look at what’s coming with this update!
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h3]New Match Types[/h3]
Two new Match Types have been added: Killrace and Team Killrace!
[list]
[*] Kill as many players as quickly as you can - the first to reach 20 (solo) or 30 (team) wins!
[*] Players are able to respawn quickly using new respawn pods littered around the new maps. Just select them as you would any trap, and after a few seconds you’ll be jumping back into the action!
There is a small period of invulnerability after respawning. This will be indicated on your weapon HUD. While you are invulnerable, you also can't shoot.
After 20 seconds in spectator mode, you will respawn automatically at a random pod.
[*] There are still the usual traps around the map too - use them to get revenge on someone else, or help your team, before jumping in a respawn pod.
[/list]

[h3]New Maps[/h3]
To facilitate the higher speed action, two new maps have been added - Twilight Divide and Umbral Rift!
[list]
[*] Both maps are around twice the size of our original set.
[*] For now, these maps will only appear on the Killrace game mode.
[/list]
[h3]New Weapons[/h3]
Variant weapons for the Pistol and Abolition Shotgun have been added - the Scarab and Impunity!
[list]
[*] The Scarab is an automatic pistol that trades a little damage per hit for a lot of coverage!
[*] The Impunity is a burst-fire shotgun that fires two shells in quick succession per trigger pull. It's got a lot of kick, but if you can control it, you will have an incredible amount of damage and space control!
[*] Both new weapons will appear in the same way the original two weapons do - they now form a pool that each game round will pull from at random.
[/list]
[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]
A first iteration of Leaderboards has been implemented! 
[list]
[*] For now, this shows The Elite 10; the 10 highest scoring players in terms of total wins, kills and points earned across all game modes. Can you make it to the top?!
[/list]
[h2]Fixes and Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] There should be another general performance increase, particularly for PC variants. We will continue to work on this as time goes on!
[*] Continued improvements on the settings menu in terms of responsiveness and correctness.
[*] Your locker skin setup is once again properly remembered between instances of the game.
[*] You should now enter gameplay with the correct weapon skin as selected in the locker.
[*] The uncooperative UV light on Shadowpoint Cross should now be working correctly, after swapping light bulbs.
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some strings are still missing from the Chinese (Simplified) translation, though only a few remain.
[*] If you are in the settings menu as a spectator when the round ends, the menu will reopen once the new round begins.
[*] If you start firing directly after sprinting, the animation will look like you are firing upwards (although any bullets will be fired in the correct direction)
[*] Both the player and their drone can fail to move immediately if you were holding forward before gaining control.
[*] Triggering a trap will also cause you to be unable to select respawn pods for the duration of the cooldown. This is unintentional - you should be able to select respawn pods regardless of your trap status. You will still auto-respawn after 20 seconds, even if you can't select the respawn pods due to a trap cooldown.
[*] The announcer can be a little… overzealous at times. He will sometimes announce a draw even when there is a clear winner. He will sometimes announce First Blood when that isn't the case.
[*] After you respawn, you will sometimes spawn with the incorrect weapon skin.
[*] The leaderboards sometimes fail to attribute the results of Kill Race matches to the relevant player. 
[/list]

notes.title: New Weapon Variants Incoming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/87d0525267c2761f715192dda11c7dc06726fc6e.png[/img]
The countdown to Race to Kill is on, and we’re excited to unveil two powerful new weapon variants arriving on [b]November 21st[/b] with our upcoming content update. These additions will double the current weapon lineup from two to four. While they are variants of existing weapons, they bring unique mechanics and play-styles that set them apart from their originals. Let’s take a closer look!


[b]The Scarab 🕷️[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/4a3cec54810c08dfa6db86bb6e675e243b804aec.png[/img]
Say hello to chaos! This new pistol variant brings a faster rate of fire, a larger magazine capacity, and a full-auto shooting mode, making it THE weapon for high-intensity action. Every round with the Scarab cranks up the heat, and we can’t wait for you to give it a shot.


[b]The Impunity 🔥[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/bdd46788e4ceba0fd58c0dfe9bba02bef0f74c0a.png[/img]
The shotgun has always been a force to be reckoned with, but the Impunity variant takes close-range combat to a whole new level with its two burst shots. It’s deadlier and more efficient up close, though you’ll notice a drop in damage at longer distances. Perfect for those who like to get up close and personal.

These new additions are just the beginning of what Race to Kill has in store. Get ready to test them out and dominate the arena starting November 21st!

notes.title: New Roadmap Changes!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/b55c44bca504b7b42a551d23a9d8f559096f2cb2.png[/img]

Hello contestants!

After reviewing our community feedback and reassessing the timeline, we’ve decided to make some adjustments to the roadmap to start implementing some of your suggestions sooner then initially planned. One popular request that we keep seeing is for a game mode that keeps players fully engaged and in constant action. So, to address that we’re introducing a new mode called  [b]Kill Race[/b]!

In  [b]Kill Race[/b], you’ll face off in the arena with up to 7 other players, respawning immediately upon death. The goal is to reach 30 eliminations and whoever gets there first wins. In the team version of Kill Race, two teams of up to 4 players compete, with the first team to achieve 50 total eliminations claiming victory. Kill Race offers a more balanced experience, allowing for easier comebacks and thrilling competition. We can’t wait for you to try it out!

Alongside the new game mode, we're also introducing Global Leaderboards [i](in an experimental phase)[/i] and new weapon variants to add even more excitement to the gameplay!

Due to this major November update, the December update will be a bit lighter. But don’t worry as you can still expect some fantastic new cosmetics and additional map traps that will totally change up the way you play Blindfire!

Come January, we’ll be back with another major content update, featuring a brand-new game mode and extensive player progression to keep you engaged. We’re thrilled to bring you all this new content and can’t wait for you to dive in. Get ready to light them up!!!

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello contestants… [/h3]
Our team has been hard at work on Patch 2, and we're exited to finally release it! This update focuses primarily on performance improvements, especially for PC players, to create a smoother gameplay experience. Let us know how the game is running for you now!

[h1]Fixes and changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] There is a new game mode flow that now allows players to select between Quick, Solo or Team play. This is in preparation of new match types being introduced soon - for now we want to keep everyone in as few queue pools as possible. As the game grows, we will revisit how we manage queueing for modes.
[*] You can now access the Locker while in a Squad, and while in the queue for matchmaking! The Locker will automatically close when joining a game, so be careful when making changes!
[*] The settings menu should behave a little better, and should reflect the changes you make more often.
[*] There has been what we hope should be a significant performance improvement, particularly for any setting configuration that doesn’t have Reflection Settings set to Lumen.
[*] Crossplay restrictions should once again be respected if you choose to put them in place.
[*] Player names during the end of round winner banner should more consistently be shown.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] The end of round replay can show shots passing through objects and walls - this is purely as a result of latency when attempting to recreate the shot. The actual gameplay shot did hit legitimately!
[*] Some strings are still missing from the Chinese (Simplified) translation.
[*] A UV light on Shadowpoint Cross fails to illuminate the skins of players caught under it.
[*] It is still possible to end up in an uneven Team Bodycount match, where the only eligible players are in squads that can't create even sided groups. For example, if a squad of 3 and a squad of 2 are the only players available and they become matched, it won't split up the squad of 3, and will instead give you an uneven 3v2 match.
[*] The skin you choose for your weapon isn't being used in matches. The skin for the rest of your body type is unaffected.
[*] If you are in the settings menu as a spectator when the round ends, the menu will reopen once the new round begins.
[*] Some settings dont have descriptions yet.
[*] The Overseer light hack completion bar doesn't match how long it takes to cool down.
[*] If you start firing directly after sprinting, the animation will look like you are firing upwards (although any bullets will be fired in the correct direction)
[*] Both the player and their drone can fail to move immediately if you were holding forward before gaining control.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Update 1 is here! We’ve focused on your feedback to make sure we addressed most of the issues that you are experiencing. Our biggest win for this update is resolving the matchmaking hiccups! We'll be keeping an eye on things to catch any new issues with matchmaking if they persist, or arise. If you run into anything weird, just let us know on Discord or on Twitter. Now, let’s dive into the patch notes!

[h2]Fixes and Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players should find themselves a little less likely to end up in a 1v1 match.
[*] The loading screen should now let you know how many players are in the lobby, how many players you are waiting for to connect, and how long until their request to join the game times out. This also replaces the “Waiting for Server” screen.
[*] Drones can now travel just a little less far out towards the windows, hopefully stopping them from getting completely stuck.
[*] The shotgun animation should no longer loop infinitely.
[*] The shotgun no longer continues to reload if you break the animation to fire again.
[*] There is no longer a very very small chance of everyone falling through the floor at the start of the match.
[*] Players should no longer have a small chance to start the match without a gun.
[*] Most settings and Keybindings should now save between instances of the game. Quality Preset still sometimes misbehaves!
[*] There should be less clutter around the Winners Showcase (although the mystery shotgun may have eluded our grasp).
[*] The game should no longer freeze where internet connection was lost during matchmaking.
[*] You should no longer be able to report yourself (sorry!).
[*] The Pistol should no longer clip through the player's leg while looking at gun skins in the Locker.
[*] Character models should no longer briefly T-pose while opening the locker or starting a Squad.
[*] Music should once again be audible after returning to the lobby after completing a match.
[*] The player's model should no longer sometimes jitter in the main menu.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] The end of round replay can show shots passing through objects and walls - this is purely as a result of latency when attempting to recreate the shot. The actual gameplay shot did hit legitimately!
[*] Round winner names are sometimes not shown correctly.
[*] Some strings are still missing from the Chinese (Simplified) translation.
[*] A UV light on Shadowpoint Cross fails to illuminate the skins of players caught under it.
[*] It is still possible to end up in an uneven Team Bodycount match, where the only eligible players are in squads that can't create even sided groups.
[*] For example, if a squad of 3 and a squad of 2 are the only players available and they become matched, it won't split up the squad of 3, and will instead give you an uneven 3v2 match.
[*] The skin you choose for your weapon isn't being used in matches. The skin for the rest of your body type is unaffected.
[*] If you are in the settings menu as a spectator when the round ends, the menu will reopen once the new round begins.
[*] Some settings don't have descriptions yet.
[*] The Overseer light hack completion bar doesn't match how long it takes to cool down.
[*] If you start firing directly after sprinting, the animation will look like you are firing upwards (although any bullets will be fired in the correct direction).
[*] Both the player and their drone can fail to move immediately if you were holding forward before gaining control.
[/list]

notes.title: The Road Ahead
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/0717acd78950615506ed579454bee519c6e31e54.png[/img]

We’re so happy to finally get [i]Blindfire[/i] into your hands and to see you enjoying the game! Our goal is to make [i]Blindfire[/i] as fun and unique as possible for you and your group of friends. We believe in our vision, but we also know that every new idea has room to grow, and that’s exactly what we’re working on during this early access phase.
 
[i]Blindfire[/i] isn’t here to compete with the big shooter games. Our goal is simple: to give you and your gaming group a fresh, entertaining experience. With your feedback and support, we can make this vision a reality! I’ll be personally reading through all your comments to make sure we address them.
 
If you’re curious to learn more about [i]Blindfire[/i] and see what’s coming next, I invite you to check out our first Dev Blog. You can follow [url=https://www.blindfiregame.com/news/releasing-blindfire-into-the-world]this link[/url] or read it below.
 
Thanks so much for being part of this journey, and I’ll see you in the arena!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/4faf869f99d1d7747b9cad1caad65056a8f2446a.jpg[/img]

[b]RELEASING BLINDFIRE INTO THE WORLD![/b]

What happens when you limit one of the most crucial elements of any FPS game? How would players react when they can’t see their opponent, but know they could be just a small step away? These questions became the driving force behind [i]Blindfire[/i], leading us to create an experience that’s both familiar and completely unique.

As our first original IP at Double Eleven, we set out to take bold risks and craft something truly distinctive. Our goal was to create a fresh concept that pushes boundaries, while still being accessible and enjoyable for a wide range of players. Our goal is to create a fun, immersive experience that keeps you engaged and always coming back for more. We’ve designed the gameplay to strike a balance between tension, adrenaline-fueled action, and the chaos of Hollywood-style gunfights, while integrating stealth mechanics that reward strategic thinking. It’s not just about fast reflexes as every decision matters. In [i]Blindfire[/i], survival often hinges on that one, perfectly timed move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/26e8a7cee744b2443bcbea1b94ca142a4bdae25b.png[/img]

The FPS landscape is packed with exceptional titles, so we knew we needed more than just a fresh gameplay twist to truly stand out. That’s where our neon-soaked, blacklight art style comes in, adding an extra layer of atmosphere. As each match progresses, you’ll witness a visual transformation, with vibrant neon highlights piercing through the darkness. In an arena dominated by shadows, these glowing elements create a deeper sense of immersion and intensity. We hope the striking visuals not only catch your eye, but also leave a memorable impression once you experience them firsthand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259657/6f5c813e5ae3416af9001469b588990947ace92a.png[/img]

Equally important, we’ve put a lot of thought into Blindfire’s game modes. After exploring countless ideas for how the game should progress and which objectives would keep players hooked, we ultimately chose to launch with Bodycount. This round-based mode awards points for kills, assists, and special feats with a focus on bold or stylish gunplay. After five rounds, the player with the most points emerges victorious. And because gaming is even more fun with friends, we’re also releasing a Team Bodycount mode, where squads of up to four players can team up for a more tactical experience. Just be careful of being caught up in friendly fire!

Looking ahead, our roadmap is packed with exciting new game modes, but for now, Bodycount is the foundation on which we’ll build. This will allow us to gather valuable feedback and keep the community united as we refine and expand the game. We can’t wait for you to dive in and experience it for yourself!

[b]MAPPING OUR FUTURE[/b]

We’re fully committed to transparency throughout [i]Blindfire’s[/i] Early Access journey. Our roadmap is packed with exciting updates, and while we aim to meet the dates we've set, we also know that flexibility is key. If any unexpected issues arise, or if the community strongly requests certain features, we might adjust the timing or order of these updates.

Rest assured, any changes will be made with your best interests in mind, as we’re dedicated to delivering the best possible experience. We’re excited to have you along for the ride and can’t wait to show you what’s next for [i]Blindfire[/i]. Without further ado, here’s the upcoming updates we have planned for the foreseeable future!

[b]CONTENT UPDATE - IN THE SPOTLIGHT - NOVEMBER 2024[/b]
[list]
[*] New weapon - Auto Pistol
[*] New weapon - Burst Shotgun
[*] New Game Mode - Spotlight & Team Spotlight
[*] Maps - Aditional Map Variants for the Spotlight Game Mode
[/list]
[b]CONTENT UPDATE - UP IN SMOKE - DECEMBER 2024[/b]
[list]
[*] New Feature - Utilities system 
[*] New Utilities - EMP Grenade & Smoke Grenade
[*] New Feature - Progression system with cosmetic unlockables
[*] New Feature - Private Matches
[*] Misc. - QOL improvements
[/list]
[b]CONTENT UPDATE - DEVOLUTION - Q1 2025[/b]
[list]
[*] New Weapon - Devolver
[*] New Utilities - Frag Grenade & UV Grenade
[*] New Game Mode - Standout & Team Standout
[*] New Feature - In-Game Voice chat
[*] New Feature - Training Room
[*] New Feature - Time Trial
[*] New Feature - Shooting Range
[*] Misc. - QOL improvements
[*] Misc. - HUD Customization
[/list]
[b]CONTENT UPDATE - KING OF THE THRILL - Q1 2025[/b]
[list]
[*] New Weapons - Devolver Variants
[*] New Game Mode - King of the Hill & Team King of the Hill
[*] Maps - Additional Map Variants
[/list]
[b]CONTENT UPDATE - MURDER ON THE DANCEFLOOR - Q1 2025[/b]
[list]
[*] New Weapon - Melee
[*] New Map Theme - Nightclub Theme
[*] New Maps - Nightclub maps
[*] New Blindfire traps
[*] New feature - Item pick-ups
[*] New Interactions in the Vengeance Toolkit
[/list]
To stay in the loop, we have a dedicated page on our website for the roadmap, which we’ll update regularly. Any changes or additions will be communicated clearly. For the latest news, visit the site often or follow us on [url=https://x.com/LightThemUpGame]Twitter/X[/url]. We’ve got a lot planned, so stay tuned!

[b]BE PART OF THE JOURNEY![/b]

As you can see from our roadmap, we have plenty of exciting content planned for [i]Blindfire[/i], but before we roll out all the features, we want to ensure we’re building on a solid foundation and going in the right direction. That’s why the Early Access period is so crucial to us.

During this period, we’re focused on delivering fast updates and refining the game as we go. We’ll be watching closely to see what works and where improvements are needed, making tweaks to keep enhancing your experience. This is where you come in. Your feedback will be essential in helping us shape the future of [i]Blindfire[/i]. We’ve set up dedicated channels on our Discord server where you can directly share your insights with the team.  We want you to be part of the journey, helping us to refine the game as we evolve it into something truly special.

Before we wrap up this dev blog, we want to set the right expectations for everyone. Since [i]Blindfire[/i] is in Early Access, you might encounter some bugs, performance hiccups, or server issues along the way. We’re actively developing and making rapid changes, so while things may occasionally break, our team is fully committed to addressing any issues as quickly as possible.

We also understand that some of you may not love the idea of creating a separate Epic Games account to play the game. However, this is crucial for enabling cross-platform play, ensuring faster queue times, and making sure you can jump into matches with minimal delay. Using Epic Games also helps us focus on delivering new content without worrying about platform compatibility. We appreciate your understanding and support in this area.

We’re thrilled to have you with us on this journey and are working hard to create something special for all of you. That’s it for now! I can’t wait to meet you on the battlefield. See you in the arena!

notes.title: New multiplayer shooter Blindfire has a unique dark mechanic and it's out now
notes.notes:
There's a trend among certain restaurants where diners sit in the dark, trusting the waiting staff and their remaining senses to enjoy the food placed in front of them. It's a way of heightening taste and removing sight from the equation, and that's exactly what new multiplayer FPS Blindfire is doing with its penumbral setting. What's more, it's already out for you to play in early access.
